lines.text: The LORD will send sword, famine and plague against the people still in Jerusalem, because they have not listened to His words.
The LORD will deliver Ahab and Zedekiah to the king of Egypt, and he will kill them before the exiles' eyes.
The LORD says Ahab and Zedekiah committed adultery with their neighbors' wives and spoke lies in His name.
Shemaiah sent letters in his own name asking the priest Zephaniah why he had not rebuked Baruch of Anathoth.
Zephaniah read the letter to Jeremiah, and the LORD said He would punish Shemaiah because he preached rebellion against the LORD.
